content_blocks.label: clause_1._NOTICE
content_blocks.text: You are hereby given notice that you are in violation of your lease agreement.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_REASON_FOR_NOTICE
content_blocks.text: The reason for this notice is your failure to pay rent as required by the lease agreement.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._TERMINATION_DATE
content_blocks.text: Your tenancy shall terminate on April 15, 2024, unless you cure the default within ten (10) days from the date hereof.
